input.free_text_description: This system is a microservices platform that serves User, Admin roles. It manages core business objects including user. It exposes interfaces for managing sample api. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include authentication functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to create and manage user records, so that I can track and organize user data effectively.
As a User, I want to interact with sample api functionality, so that I can accomplish my sample api-related tasks.
As a User, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
